decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR and commit [ev-3881a5911482][ev-7e7223c9cf76] fill in what the changelog line [ev-b4198e6a82a9] leaves out. Subject: how the ring LifecyclerConfig constructors combine the instance addr and port. Change: all constructors now use `net.JoinHostPort`, which makes IPv6 work. Before this fix, only distributors (through `Lifecycler`) were IPv6-compatible; components using `BasicLifecycler` relied on the operator to supply the addr/port combination. The changed files [ev-87ec3af1d884][ev-182eeb0b2a55] place the fix in the distributor ring, the ruler ring and the shared `pkg/util/ring/ring_config.go`, so exposure is ring members other than distributors configured with an IPv6 instance address.
